entry.topic: ICES September 11 neural-network pollock harvest-policy simulations
entry.archetype: instrument rehearsal through separate biological cases
entry.palette: bright ultramarine mango alabaster sea-glass ink navy
entry.angle: This pollock study demonstrates a way to explore harvest choices before real seasons. Under two recruitment assumptions, learned policies produce different combinations of catch and breeding-stock outcomes. That earns further comparison against explicit management goals without establishing a winning real-world rule.
